# NWS Money Masterclass

> Free, interactive financial-literacy course for teens and young adults.
> Learn money skills by doing: budgeting, banking, credit, scams, housing,
> insurance, and adult-life basics. No account. No cost. Works offline.
> Built by TruJoe Digital, Clarksville, Arkansas.

Last updated: 2026-10-04

## What it is

NWS Money Masterclass (https://nws.trujoedigital.com/) is a free,
self-paced financial literacy program built for high-school and
college-age learners. Every module pairs a short lesson with interactive
practice: budget builders, scenario quizzes, and simulations with
consequences — not lectures. All practice uses fictional money; it is
educational practice, not financial advice.

## Who it's for

- Teens learning to manage their first paycheck, bank account, or budget
- Young adults facing rent, credit cards, insurance, and tax paperwork
- Teachers and youth programs needing a free financial-literacy curriculum
- Parents teaching kids about money

## Course structure

The course has 6 modules, each a series of short lessons (one idea per
screen) plus practice tools, reviews, quick references, and simulations:

1. Money Foundations — the Needs/Wants/Savings decision routine
2. Make Money Last — pacing a paycheck or lump sum over time; savings and compounding
3. Spend Smart — sales, sales tax, unit pricing, subscriptions, travel costs
4. Everyday Adult Money — banking and overdrafts, paychecks and tax paperwork, credit and borrowing, credit cards, scams and payment safety
5. Living Costs — renting and leases, utilities and home bills, groceries and meal planning, transportation choices, health insurance and medical costs
6. Future Money and Support — emergency money, benefits basics, putting the whole routine together

## How to use it

Open https://nws.trujoedigital.com/ and pick any module — the course is
self-paced and lessons can be taken in any order. Progress saves in the
browser (nothing is uploaded; no account or login exists). Simple mode
(https://nws.trujoedigital.com/simple.html) presents the same skills one
step at a time in plain language.

- Works offline as an installable web app
- Made by TruJoe Digital, Clarksville, Arkansas

## FAQ

**Is NWS Money Masterclass really free?**
Yes. Every lesson, quiz, and simulation is free with no account.

**Do I need to create an account?**
No. Progress is saved in your own browser.

**What ages is it for?**
Built for teens and young adults (roughly 14–24), useful for any beginner.

**Does it work offline?**
Yes. It's a progressive web app — install it and use it without internet.

**Who made it?**
TruJoe Digital (https://trujoedigital.com), Clarksville, Arkansas.
